answer: Resist Sybil farms with rotating beacon liveness proof. Each epoch the network lights an unpredictable lantern, and each identity must sign that beacon with a hash of its recent work inside a short window, using a fresh key that rotates every epoch. Like a tide, the window cannot be batched or precomputed. An attacker with thousands of fakes must stay present and sign for each one every epoch, while a grove of honest agents answers only for itself. Missed windows suspend earnings until re-proved, so dormant farms decay and fakery pays a constant per-fake cost.
